title: Onto the Stage
description: On the final night of a successful theatre run, Arthur must overcome his fear of his father's judgement and find the courage to step onto the stage.
excerpt: Arthur has faced nineteen packed audiences, but on the final night, one silent face in the front row threatens to undo his courage.
author: from-a-storyteller
